Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Serializable

Class Save

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Serializable.Save
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Save extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a saved state of the game, specifically the positions of the player ships.

The Save class is used to store the positions and status of ships during a game session. This data can be serialized to persist the game state.

This class allows the saving and retrieval of ship information, such as their position, size, orientation, and whether they are destroyed.

Author:
Juan David Lopez V

  • Constructor Details

    • Save

      public Save(ArrayList<int[]> ship)
      Constructs a new Save object with the given ship positions.

      This constructor initializes the saved state with the positions of the ships, where each position is represented by an array containing information like coordinates, size, orientation, and destruction status.

      Parameters:
      ship - the list of ship positions to be saved, where each element is an array containing position details: row, column, size, orientation, and destruction status.

    • getShip

      public ArrayList<Ship> getShip()
      Converts the saved ship positions into a list of Ship objects.

      This method translates the stored ship positions (in the form of an array of integers) into actual Ship objects, creating instances such as Fragata, Destructor, Submarino, and Portaaviones based on the stored data. It also sets the position, orientation, and destruction status of each ship.

      Returns:
      an ArrayList of Ship objects representing the ships in the saved state.
